title: "Elastography" and "Tissue Harmonic Imaging" for Characterisation of Hilar and Mediastinal Lymph Nodes
brief_summary: Several benign and malignant diseases are associated with hilar and mediastinal lymphadenopathy. Endobronchial elastography that is an imaging procedure used for the visualization of tissue elasticity and "Tissue Harmonic Imaging (THI)" might be useful for the differentiation of benign and malignant lymph nodes.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Indication for EBUS-TBNA
